decisions.reason: The conferencing service still supports enterprise voice customers but faces intense competition, making withdrawal a moderate possibility.
Metro data centre connectivity is core to the firm’s infrastructure strategy and has demonstrated market adoption.
Optical spectrum connectivity supports high-bandwidth, software-defined services and remains strategically important.
The voice number ordering portal improves digital self-service and operational efficiency, though it may be absorbed into broader platforms.
Carrier pre-selection telephony is a legacy service with sharply declining demand and no longer fits the firm’s software-defined infrastructure direction.
